description: Signal-level fault detection (GBT, Isolation Forest vs conventional per-segment detector), deterministic integrity track, and CUSUM tuning. Synthetic data only.
post_event_transient_note: Evaluation-only context windows: voltage ~instantaneous; current 3 x 45 s shunt thermal time constant; temperature 5 x 20 s sensor time constant (simulation parameters).
selection_rule: maximise validation macro event recall over signal fault classes at the validation-tuned threshold (FAR <= target on validation negatives); tie-break by validation record-level F1

baseline.name: DataQualityAssessor per protocol segment
baseline.notes: Uses config/default_config.json range limits, max_rate_of_change and MAD threshold. Non-causal within a segment (MAD uses the whole segment) and uses operator protocol information (segment boundaries) that the ML detectors do not receive.

cusum.selection_rule: on calibration+validation runs only: require ARL0 (Siegmund) >= 10 x longest run, zero alarms on control runs and zero pre-onset alarms on drift runs; then maximise detected drift runs, then minimise median delay, then prefer larger ARL0
cusum.error_series: static-calibrated DUT reading minus reference reading, integrity-clean records only; temperature restricted to protocol steady / plateau_stable phases
